title: Cashier's Basis Note: Applying a Payment to a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
A payment on an account of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts is applied to the invoices it names, and where it names none it is applied in the programme's allocation order.

**Oldest invoice first.** On an oldest-invoice-first order the payment clears the oldest open invoice in full before any of the next.

**Prepay first.** On a prepay-first order any prepay standing to the member's credit is drawn before their own money is taken.

**Routes.** Payments may reach the cooperative only by the methods the programme allows, so a member on a cash programme cannot direct grain proceeds onto the account and must be paid for their grain and pay the invoice separately.

**Grain settlement proceeds.** Where the member has elected on a grain settlement to have the proceeds credited to their input account, the whole net of that settlement lands on the account as one payment on the settlement date and is applied in the ordinary order; it is not split across accounts and it is not held back to await the member's instruction.

**Part payment on an overdue balance.** A part payment on an overdue balance is accepted only at or above the programme's minimum part payment as a share of the balance, and a smaller offer is declined rather than accepted and left to fall short of reinstatement.

**The day a payment counts.** Payments are applied on the day they are received, and a payment received after the office closes is applied the next day the office is open, which matters where it lands against a due date.

## Condition and result

| The payment | The result on a Crop Input Purchasing Account |
| --- | --- |
| Names the invoices it is for | Applied to those invoices |
| Names none, oldest-invoice-first programme | The oldest open invoice is cleared in full first |
| Names none, prepay-first programme | Prepay standing to the member's credit is drawn before their own money |
| Comes by a route the programme does not allow | Not taken by that route |
| Is a grain settlement the member elected onto the account | The whole net lands as one payment on the settlement date, applied in the ordinary order |
| Is offered below the programme's minimum part payment on an overdue balance | Declined |
| Is received after the office closes | Applied the next day the office is open |

The allowed routes, the allocation order and the minimum part payment are each the figure the member's programme carries in the member terms for ways to pay.
